noPlan.decisiveGap: With no up-front spend, the only channel that can settle in 14 days (Upwork, 5-day hold after approval) gives 10 free Connects - at most ~10 and likely fewer proposals - while $3,000 needs ~7 funded wins (~$450 net each) approved by about day 9; no win rate, paid price or owner hours are measured, and Freelancer.com's free bids cannot settle before its up-to-15-day first-withdrawal hold ends.
noPlan.resolution: Zero-cost check (t1-t3): spend only the 10 free Connects on fixed-price web jobs >= $400 and have the owner state build hours. PROOF (the only result that keeps $3,000 by day 14 alive): >= 7 funded milestones averaging >= $450 net with approvals feasible by day 9 and >= 56 owner hours - not attainable from <= 10 proposals unless nearly every one wins. STOP (expected): fewer - report that $3,000 in 14 days with no up-front spend is not reachable on these channels and offer the owner two relaxations to decide: (a) allow ~$15-30 of Connects (at $0.15 each, s6-adjacent pricing unverified) for ~100-200 more Connects, or (b) a ~30-day window so Freelancer.com's free 100-bid Plus trial and its first withdrawal (held up to 15 days, s4) can settle. CONTINUE: only if proof is met.

answers.finding: Recomputed: $3,000 / (~$450 net per $500 job) = 6.7 -> 7 wins; 7 x 8 h = 56 owner hours in 14 days.
answers.resolution: Accepted: wins needed recomputed as ~7 at ~$450 net; recorded as an ESTIMATE quantity with 56 owner hours.

answers.finding: Bid capacity: 10 free Connects/month is the whole zero-spend allowance; Connects per proposal not established - cannot be read as 10 proposals.
answers.resolution: Accepted: Connects per proposal is now UNKNOWN; the test no longer equates 10 Connects with 10 proposals, and the continuation that re-bid with 'remaining Connects' is removed.

answers.finding: Settlement: hire day 3, build, client approval, 5-day hold - the last win must be approved by about day 9 to settle by day 14.
answers.resolution: Accepted: the proof now requires approvals feasible by about day 9 so the 5-day hold ends by day 14.

answers.finding: Freelancer.com route is correctly excluded by the 15-day first-withdrawal hold (s4).
answers.resolution: Agreed: the Freelancer.com route stays excluded from in-window cash by the up-to-15-day first-withdrawal hold; it appears only in the suggested 30-day relaxation.

answers.finding: Upwork fee (0-15% per s6) is not deducted in the plan's figures.
answers.resolution: Accepted: the fee is now deducted - wins needed use ~$450 net per $500 job (0-15% fee, s6).

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is right that no opening has a paid price or a win rate, but the test cannot lead to the target and its continuation is not executable. $3,000 settled needs about 7 Upwork wins at $500 less the service fee (~$450 net), each 8 owner hours (~56 h in 14 days, owner hours unstated and so unknown). The test spends the 10 free Connects as '10 proposals', but a proposal costs Connects (the card records only '10 free Connects/month', not one per proposal), so the free allowance buys at most 10 and likely far fewer proposals; even at 100% conversion that is short of ~7 wins, and buying more Connects is up-front spend the owner excluded. The CONTINUE rule ('re-bid with remaining Connects') has nothing left to bid with. Proof '>= 1 hire by day 3' therefore does not show $3,000 is reachable; on these channels the zero-spend bid capacity plus the 5-day Upwork hold (and Freelancer's 15-day first-withdrawal hold) looks like a constraint, and the revision should say so or show a channel that fits.
findings: Recomputed: $3,000 / (~$450 net per $500 job) = 6.7 -> 7 wins; 7 x 8 h = 56 owner hours in 14 days.
Bid capacity: 10 free Connects/month is the whole zero-spend allowance; Connects per proposal not established - cannot be read as 10 proposals.
Settlement: hire day 3, build, client approval, 5-day hold - the last win must be approved by about day 9 to settle by day 14.
Freelancer.com route is correctly excluded by the 15-day first-withdrawal hold (s4).
Upwork fee (0-15% per s6) is not deducted in the plan's figures.

reviews.reasons: My findings are resolved. The revision now states the binding fact correctly: with no up-front spend, 10 free Upwork Connects buy at most ~10 and likely fewer proposals, fewer than the ~7 funded wins ($450 net each after the fee) that $3,000 needs with approvals by ~day 9 to clear the 5-day hold; Freelancer.com cannot settle before its up-to-15-day first-withdrawal hold. The $0 check is honest that STOP is the expected outcome and hands the owner two concrete relaxations (a small Connects spend, or a ~30-day window). Owner hours (~56 h) are asked, not assumed.
findings: Recomputed: 7 wins x ~$450 net = ~$3,150; 7 x 8 h = 56 owner hours in 9 days.
This reads as a constraint (zero-spend bid capacity plus settlement holds) - it could be recorded in constraints[] with the Connects and hold sources as basis, not only in prose.
The $0.15/Connect price is flagged unverified - correct; verify before offering relaxation (a).
